name: Resolution Blue
lede: Resolution Blue is a deep, saturated blue from a web color list, with no coiner or date confirmed in the sources checked here.

sections.title: An unconfirmed web name
sections.body:
The ColorHub library records Resolution Blue from Wikipedia's running list of named colors, flagged there as an obscure or qualified name rather than one in wide, independent use [1]. No book consulted here, and no reliable institutional page found online, confirms who coined the name, what it refers to, or when it entered use; several low-quality color-aggregator sites offer conflicting, unsourced stories, so the origin is left undocumented rather than repeated [1]. The hex #002387 is a screen approximation only [1].

Its nearest library neighbor is [[midnight-blue]] [1].

Other close matches in the library include [[st-patrick-s-blue]], [[royal]] and [[cosmic-cobalt]], all duller than this swatch [1].

sections.title: Field notes
sections.body: The automated archive tool used for this project could not compute a usable match count for this hex, so no painting-archive figures are given here [2]. The swatch should be read only as a screen approximation, not as evidence of how the color appears in paintings.
